policy: Unresolved items are generation blockers where they affect compatibility, XML, security, or destructive operations.

questions.question: Recover the official Claris release notes for FileMaker Pro/Server 19.5.1, 19.5.2, 19.5.3, and 19.5.4 and freeze patch-level deltas.
questions.whyUnresolved: Only secondary mirrors for some patches were recovered in this pass.
questions.risk: Patch-specific FMSE, authentication, schedule, OData, WebDirect, OpenSSL, or hosted-file fixes may be missed.
questions.verificationPlan: Acquire official Claris PDFs/pages or archived originals; hash and register each; map every relevant change to affected catalog entries.

questions.question: Confirm the exact FileMaker Server 19.5.x limit for PSOS script parameters and script results, including multibyte-character counting.
questions.whyUnresolved: Cumulative help wording and schedule UI limits can be confused.
questions.risk: Large JSON requests/results may truncate or fail.
questions.verificationPlan: Boundary tests on 19.5.4 using ASCII and Japanese UTF-8-equivalent text; record caller/server lengths, errors, and logs.

questions.question: Reconcile the Admin Console limit for script name plus parameters with the larger script parameter/result limit.
questions.whyUnresolved: They apply at different invocation/configuration layers.
questions.risk: A catalog may publish one misleading universal limit.
questions.verificationPlan: Represent as separate limits; test direct Admin Console entry, API-created schedule if available, and runtime Get(ScriptParameter).

questions.question: What exact values do global fields expose at the start of PSOS and server-schedule sessions in 19.5.4, including multi-file solutions?
questions.whyUnresolved: Documentation establishes non-inheritance but not every initialization/storage edge case.
questions.risk: Scripts may use stale/default globals as hidden input.
questions.verificationPlan: Controlled files with stored/default global values, two clients, PSOS, schedule, related files, and restart boundaries.

questions.question: Confirm $$variable lifetime and isolation across Perform Script, PSOS, nested PSOS, schedule, file open/close, and server process restart.
questions.whyUnresolved: General scope rules do not fully substitute for 19.5 FMSE observations.
questions.risk: Cross-job contamination or missing state.
questions.verificationPlan: Log session identifiers, timestamps, account, script nesting, and $$values across a matrix of execution paths.

questions.question: Map account/privilege behavior when PSOS or a schedule accesses related FileMaker files with different account sets, external authentication, or authorized-file restrictions.
questions.whyUnresolved: Single-file account rules do not resolve cross-file authentication prompts and failures.
questions.risk: Unexpected error 9, 18, 114, 803, or 825; privilege escalation assumptions.
questions.verificationPlan: Build two-file fixtures with matched/mismatched accounts and authorized-file settings; record AccountName and privilege set in each file.

questions.question: Which file, layout, record, and object script triggers fire—or do not fire—during PSOS and server schedules in 19.5.4?
questions.whyUnresolved: The original request did not enumerate triggers, but generated scripts can activate them indirectly.
questions.risk: Hidden side effects, recursion, validation changes, or missing initialization.
questions.verificationPlan: Create trigger counters/logs for OnFirstWindowOpen, OnLayoutEnter, OnModeEnter, OnRecordLoad, OnRecordCommit, and relevant object triggers.

questions.question: What state remains when an administrator stops FMSE or a schedule timeout occurs during record edits, file writes, imports, or outbound requests?
questions.whyUnresolved: Termination mechanism is documented; operation-specific atomicity is not.
questions.risk: Partial commits, duplicate retries, orphan files, or uncertain external side effects.
questions.verificationPlan: Inject controlled stops at checkpoints; verify committed records, open locks, files, logs, and external request IDs.

questions.question: Confirm 19.5.4 behavior when a schedule's next run begins before the previous run completes and when PSOS session capacity is exhausted.
questions.whyUnresolved: Configuration and operational behavior require exact version observation.
questions.risk: Dropped runs, unbounded overlap, lock storms, and duplicate work.
questions.verificationPlan: Use long-running fixture jobs, low script-session limit, overlapping schedules, nested PSOS, and Event.log capture.

questions.question: For each intended plug-in, which exact version/OS build is server-enabled, FMSE-compatible, thread-safe, and licensed for Server 19.5?
questions.whyUnresolved: Claris documents platform mechanisms; compatibility is plug-in/vendor-specific.
questions.risk: Error 1550+, wrong results, hangs, or server crashes.
questions.verificationPlan: Register vendor documentation and test cold load, concurrent calls, schedule/PSOS, restart, and failure modes on each server OS.

questions.question: Freeze the supported 64-bit ODBC driver, version, DSN type, authentication, Unicode behavior, and transaction behavior for each external source.
questions.whyUnresolved: Generic step compatibility does not prove a specific driver/source combination.
questions.risk: Encoding loss, driver crashes, authentication failure, or uncertain commits.
questions.verificationPlan: Test DSN discovery, Unicode roundtrip, long SQL, timeout, deadlock, disconnect, and Get(LastExternalErrorDetail).

questions.question: Complete desktop-browser versus mobile-browser option-level compatibility for every high-priority step.
questions.whyUnresolved: A single WebDirect boolean hides browser/device-specific restrictions.
questions.risk: Generated scripts pass catalog validation but fail on mobile browsers.
questions.verificationPlan: Add subcontexts webDirectDesktop and webDirectMobile; test supported browsers against archived pages.

questions.question: Capture FileMaker Pro 19.5-origin clipboard XML for all admitted steps and option combinations.
questions.whyUnresolved: Claris does not publish the clipboard fmxmlsnippet schema or authoritative numerical IDs.
questions.risk: Invalid paste, wrong object references, silent option changes, or use of later-version step IDs.
questions.verificationPlan: Copy one step at a time from Pro 19.5, record exact patch/Windows version, hash raw payload, paste roundtrip, and store provenance.

questions.question: Determine whether any DDR XML step IDs coincide with clipboard fmxmlsnippet IDs for 19.5 without assuming equivalence.
questions.whyUnresolved: Official DDR grammar is a different XML product and older version.
questions.risk: False officialization of observed numeric IDs.
questions.verificationPlan: Capture same step/options via 19.5 DDR and clipboard; compare structurally; keep evidence namespaces separate regardless of equality.

questions.question: Confirm open-handle limits, cleanup on Exit Script/Halt/error/timeout, and concurrent access semantics for data-file steps in 19.5.4.
questions.whyUnresolved: Individual pages document basic operation, not all FMSE termination/concurrency cases.
questions.risk: Leaked handles, partial writes, corruption, and job interference.
questions.verificationPlan: Open handles to boundaries, abort at each state, run concurrent writers, and inspect files after session termination.

questions.question: Record exact Windows/Linux/macOS server path forms, service-account permissions, Unicode filenames, overwrite behavior, and rename/replace atomicity.
questions.whyUnresolved: Logical allowed roots are documented; deployment filesystem behavior is environment-specific.
questions.risk: Cross-platform failure or unsafe overwrite.
questions.verificationPlan: Test every supported Server 19.5 OS with generated paths, Japanese filenames, collisions, permissions, and interrupted writes.

questions.question: Verify fonts, print setup, page geometry, container rendering, locale, and concurrent PDF filename behavior on the target Server 19.5 OS.
questions.whyUnresolved: Step compatibility does not prove output fidelity.
questions.risk: Incorrect or unreadable generated documents.
questions.verificationPlan: Golden-file visual and metadata comparison across client and FMSE; include Japanese fonts and missing-font cases.

questions.question: Confirm 19.5.4 request envelope limits, hidden-window layout context, privilege behavior, and result/error semantics for read/metaData actions.
questions.whyUnresolved: Archived documentation defines the surface but not every solution-specific context/security edge.
questions.risk: Wrong layout/table context, leaked fields, or false success.
questions.verificationPlan: Test read/metaData with restricted layouts/fields, related data, large JSON, malformed requests, and result.messages inspection.

questions.question: Freeze an exact FileMaker 19.5-era error-code table rather than relying on the cumulative current table for every code.
questions.whyUnresolved: Current help contains later-version codes and changed function terminology.
questions.risk: Catalog may expose codes or descriptions unavailable in 19.5.
questions.verificationPlan: Recover archived 19 error-code page/PDF, diff against current, and tag each code with introduced/last-confirmed version.

questions.question: Confirm from official Claris 19.5/19.6.1 release documentation when Get ( LastExternalErrorDetail ) was renamed or replaced by Get ( LastErrorDetail ), and whether both names coexist in any 19.x patch.
questions.whyUnresolved: The cumulative FileMaker 19 help now shows the later name and transaction-related behavior, while official older archives show LastExternalErrorDetail.
questions.risk: Generated 19.5 calculations may use a function name unavailable in the installed patch, or later semantics may be backported incorrectly.
questions.verificationPlan: Acquire official FileMaker Pro 19.5.x and 19.6.1 release notes, then test both function names in Pro/Server 19.5.4 and 19.6.1.
